Ethan invests an amount of money into an account which pays simple interest at a rate of $7\%$ per annum. Over a period of 4 years, the total interest earned is \$37,100.

How much money did Ethan invest?

solutions.latex:
Using the simple interest formula $I = Prn$:
$$\begin{aligned} 37\,100 &= P \times 7\% \times 4 \\ P &= \dfrac{37\,100}{7\% \times 4} \\ &= \$132\,500 \end{aligned}$$
Hence the answer is option C.
